sources.title: Siemens Industrial Edge ecosystem strengthens data and AI integration
sources.snippet: The Industrial AI Suite, based on Industrial Edge, is now generally available. At Hannover Messe 2026, Siemens has announced significant expansions to its Industrial Edge ecosystem, accelerating data and AI integration and releasing enhanced cybersecurity functionalities.
